text_block_list.text: We safely wrapped up training with Mejiro Bright on this day too, but she gazed into the distance and showed no signs of heading back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
...Alright, shaved down my time...!
It seems she's watching Mejiro Dober train hard in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um, would it be all right if I continued training for a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
it is perfectly fine if you head home first~.

I understand why she wants to do extra training.
In that case, the words I should say are—

I understand why she wants to do extra training.
In that case, the words I should say are—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My~! Are you quite sure?
Thank you very much, Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This won't take long at all,
so please wait just a moment~

Afterward, we both trained together
until we were completely satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see.
It seems I was rushing things, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As you suggested,
I think I'll take it easy~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So that we may walk
our own path.
